A01: bind debug runs to the validated private OSDK executable

Resolve the source-specific private SDK and verify its receipt before launching the debug build, preserving source-root identity through the TCP GDB flow.

Validation: 16 tests in isolated Python and 16 with optimization, plus independent old-failure/new-success ingress probes. Host checks establish wrapper behavior; real kernel TCP GDB execution is recorded separately.
scope: Exact selected runtime/debug controls at successful debug producer D, with commit/tree/path/blob membership; not a second kernel import.
